title: "National impact (PBS HCV treatment dataset)"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

library(pacman)
p_load(
  haven,
  dplyr,
  readr,
  ggplot2,
  scales,
  tidyr,
  lubridate,
  stringr
)

dir.create("Results/Impact", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# Load PBS dataset

```{r}
pbs_path <- "Data/Get data/PBS HCV dataset_March2025.dta"
stopifnot(file.exists(pbs_path))

pbs_raw <- read_dta(pbs_path)

year_min <- 2017

pbs_supplies <- pbs_raw %>%
  transmute(
    pt_id = as.character(pt_id),
    pt_age = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(pt_age)),
    pt_sex = haven::as_factor(pt_sex),
    supply_date = as.Date(datesupply)
  ) %>%
  mutate(year = lubridate::year(supply_date))

# Patient-year table (unique patients treated in each calendar year)
pbs_pt_year <- pbs_supplies %>%
  filter(!is.na(year), year >= year_min) %>%
  group_by(year, pt_id) %>%
  summarise(
    pt_age = suppressWarnings(first(na.omit(pt_age))),
    pt_sex = suppressWarnings(first(na.omit(pt_sex))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Patient-level first supply within the analysis period (for overall calculations)
pbs_pt_first_in_period <- pbs_supplies %>%
  filter(!is.na(year), year >= year_min, !is.na(supply_date)) %>%
  group_by(pt_id) %>%
  slice_min(supply_date, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(pt_id, pt_age, pt_sex, first_supply_date = supply_date, year)

cat("PBS supply rows:", nrow(pbs_supplies), "\n")
cat(
  "Supply date range:",
  format(min(pbs_supplies$supply_date, na.rm = TRUE)),
  "to",
  format(max(pbs_supplies$supply_date, na.rm = TRUE)),
  "\n"
)
cat("Unique patients (any year):", n_distinct(pbs_supplies$pt_id), "\n")
cat("Unique patient-years (>=", year_min, "):", nrow(pbs_pt_year), "\n", sep = "")
```

# National treatment volume

```{r}
p_by_year_df <- pbs_pt_year %>%
  count(year, name = "unique_patients") %>%
  arrange(year)

write_csv(p_by_year_df, "Results/Impact/PBS_UniquePatients_byYear.csv")

p_by_year <- p_by_year_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = unique_patients)) +
  geom_col(fill = "grey30") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(
    title = "PBS HCV treatment (unique patients by year of supply)",
    x = "Year (datesupply)",
    y = "Patients"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p_by_year
ggsave("Results/Impact/PBS_TreatedPatients_byYear.png", plot = p_by_year, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

# Age-cutoff strategy impact on fibrosis assessment

Assumption for this simple impact calculation: a fibrosis assessment (e.g., FibroScan) is required for people above an age cutoff, and is not required for those at or below the cutoff.

```{r}
cutoffs <- c(35, 40, 45, 50)

impact_overall <- pbs_pt_first_in_period %>%
  tidyr::crossing(cutoff = cutoffs) %>%
  group_by(cutoff) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_with_age = sum(!is.na(pt_age)),
    n_assess = sum(pt_age > cutoff, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_no_assess = sum(pt_age <= cutoff, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_assess = n_assess / n_with_age,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

impact_overall
write_csv(impact_overall, "Results/Impact/PBS_AgeCutoff_AssessmentImpact_overall.csv")

p_assess_overall <- impact_overall %>%
  mutate(cutoff = factor(paste0(">", cutoff), levels = paste0(">", cutoffs))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = cutoff, y = n_assess)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::comma(n_assess)), vjust = -0.3, size = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(
    title = "Estimated fibrosis assessments required (PBS treated patients)",
    x = "Age cutoff strategy",
    y = "Patients needing assessment"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p_assess_overall
ggsave("Results/Impact/PBS_AssessmentsRequired_byAgeCutoff.png", plot = p_assess_overall, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
impact_by_year <- pbs_pt_year %>%
  filter(!is.na(pt_age)) %>%
  tidyr::crossing(cutoff = cutoffs) %>%
  group_by(year, cutoff) %>%
  summarise(
    n_treated = n(),
    n_assess = sum(pt_age > cutoff),
    n_no_assess = sum(pt_age <= cutoff),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv(impact_by_year, "Results/Impact/PBS_AgeCutoff_AssessmentImpact_byYear.csv")

p_assess_by_year <- impact_by_year %>%
  mutate(cutoff = factor(cutoff)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n_assess, color = cutoff, group = cutoff)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2", name = "Cutoff") +
  labs(
    title = "Assessments required over time under age-cutoff strategies",
    x = "Year (first supply)",
    y = "Patients needing assessment"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p_assess_by_year
ggsave("Results/Impact/PBS_AssessmentsRequired_byAgeCutoff_byYear.png", plot = p_assess_by_year, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

# Illustrative extrapolation: expected high FSM among those not assessed

This section applies the age-bin prevalence of high FSM from the study cohort (Data/merged_data.csv) to the PBS-treated patient counts.

```{r}
cohort_path <- "Data/merged_data.csv"
stopifnot(file.exists(cohort_path))

cohort <- readr::read_csv(cohort_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(age), !is.na(fsm)) %>%
  mutate(
    age_bin = cut(
      age,
      breaks = c(-Inf, 35, 40, 45, Inf),
      right = FALSE,
      labels = c("<35", "35-39", "40-44", "45+")
    ),
    fsm_12_5 = fsm >= 12.5,
    fsm_20 = fsm >= 20
  )

prev_by_agebin <- cohort %>%
  group_by(age_bin) %>%
  summarise(
    n_cohort = n(),
    prev_fsm_12_5 = mean(fsm_12_5),
    prev_fsm_20 = mean(fsm_20),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv(prev_by_agebin, "Results/Impact/Cohort_Prevalence_byAgeBin.csv")

pbs_pt_bins <- pbs_pt_first_in_period %>%
  filter(!is.na(pt_age)) %>%
  mutate(
    age_bin = cut(
      pt_age,
      breaks = c(-Inf, 35, 40, 45, Inf),
      right = FALSE,
      labels = c("<35", "35-39", "40-44", "45+")
    )
  )

missed_tbl <- tidyr::crossing(cutoff = cutoffs) %>%
  mutate(
    n_not_assessed = vapply(cutoff, function(c) sum(pbs_pt_bins$pt_age <= c), numeric(1)),
    exp_missed_fsm_12_5 = vapply(cutoff, function(c) {
      pbs_pt_bins %>%
        filter(pt_age <= c) %>%
        count(age_bin, name = "n") %>%
        left_join(prev_by_agebin, by = "age_bin") %>%
        summarise(exp = sum(n * prev_fsm_12_5, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
        pull(exp)
    }, numeric(1)),
    exp_missed_fsm_20 = vapply(cutoff, function(c) {
      pbs_pt_bins %>%
        filter(pt_age <= c) %>%
        count(age_bin, name = "n") %>%
        left_join(prev_by_agebin, by = "age_bin") %>%
        summarise(exp = sum(n * prev_fsm_20, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
        pull(exp)
    }, numeric(1))
  )

write_csv(missed_tbl, "Results/Impact/PBS_EstimatedMissedFSM_byAgeCutoff.csv")
missed_tbl

p_missed <- missed_tbl %>%
  mutate(cutoff = factor(paste0("<=", cutoff), levels = paste0("<=", cutoffs))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = cutoff, y = exp_missed_fsm_12_5)) +
  geom_col(fill = "firebrick") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(
    title = "Expected FSM >= 12.5 among not-assessed (illustrative)",
    x = "Not assessed group definition",
    y = "Expected FSM >= 12.5"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p_missed
ggsave("Results/Impact/PBS_EstimatedMissedFSM12_5_byAgeCutoff.png", plot = p_missed, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```
